units.source_text: 我向大书院老师的房间走去。

en.t: I walked toward the priest's room in the Great Shoin.

units.source_text: 擅长于这种事的副司正在给老师剃头。

en.t: The assistant priest, skilled at this sort of thing, was shaving the priest's head.

units.source_text: 我就在洒满晨光的廊道上等候着。

en.t: I waited there in the corridor flooded with morning light.
